_README: Declared, accepted test failures for scripts/ciSuite.mjs.
This is NOT an exclusion list. Every file in tests/ still runs. An entry
here only says: this exact failure, with this exit code and this message,
is already known. If the file fails for a DIFFERENT reason the runner
reports SIGNATURE_CHANGED and the build fails. If it starts passing the
runner reports UNEXPECTED_PASS and the build also fails, so the list
Recorded from run #69 on ubuntu-latest at commit d530e34: 128 files
discovered, 128 executed, 128 completed, 106 pass, 22 fail. Every
signature below was checked against that run's captured log.
launchCompliance.test.mjs is deliberately NOT listed. It failed only
because the suite job did not install the frontend's dependencies, which
the workflow now does. It is a CI defect, not an accepted failure.
A reason must say what the defect is and what would let the entry be
removed. 'Known failure' is not a reason. Entries marked DEFECT are real
product bugs and should be fixed, not kept.

answerStateCorpus.test.mjs.reason: BOOKKEEPING. The recorded answer-state corpus no longer matches what the engine produces. Remove once the corpus is re-recorded against intentional clause-set changes.
signature_contains: The answer-state corpus has drifted:

certificationDimensions.test.mjs.reason: BOOKKEEPING. Three of the ten earned falsification results have been lost from the recorded evidence. Remove once the missing evidence is re-gathered, or the expected count is lowered deliberately.
signature_contains: earned falsification results to be preserved, got

clauseProvenance.test.mjs.reason: GOVERNANCE. 316 unreviewed clauses against a pinned ceiling of 307. Remove by getting the nine new clauses reviewed, or by raising the ceiling deliberately.
signature_contains: unreviewed clause count rose to
above the pinned ceiling of 307

declinedProtections.test.mjs.reason: DEFECT. A protection the user declined still appears in the draft under a different clause id. The engine honours the identifier, not the role. Remove when the role is honoured.
signature_contains: a protection the user declined is present under some clause id

documentHealthScore.test.mjs.reason: DEFECT, catalogue-wide and the most serious entry here. Only 29 types generate at all, and only 14 of those 29 are clean. The test itself says a defect common to the whole catalogue is the likely cause. Remove when the catalogue generates clean again.
signature_contains: only 29 types generated; this file cannot report on a corpus that small
only 14 of 29 types are clean

gateReachability.test.mjs.reason: BOOKKEEPING. Gates recorded as frozen have since been repaired, so the test's KNOWN_FROZEN list is stale. Remove once those lines are deleted.
signature_contains: Frozen gate(s) repaired but still recorded as known

intakeModes.test.mjs.reason: DEFECT. Quick mode lists company_address as an essential field for TERMS_OF_SERVICE while the document config does not make it required, so 'essentials are a subset of required' is violated. The Gemini 403 lines in this log are unrelated noise (see the offline note in the workflow).
signature_contains: essentials are always a subset of the document's required fields
essential "company_address" must also be a required field

loanApplicability.test.mjs.reason: DEFECT. The loan fixture does not generate at all. Probably the same root cause as positionOverride.test.mjs and the documentHealthScore corpus shortfall.
signature_contains: the loan fixture must generate

loanSecurityTreatment.test.mjs.reason: DEFECT, known engine limitation. The dependency resolver does not consult applicability, so LOAN_DEFAULT_001.required_with reinstates LOAN_SECURITY_001 on every unsecured loan. Remove when the resolver consults applicability.
signature_contains: The dependency resolver does not consult applicability

numericPlausibility.test.mjs.reason: DEFECT. At least one numeric intake field carries no plausibility bound, so an implausible figure can reach a draft unchallenged.
signature_contains: every numeric intake field carries a bound

optionalFieldSafety.test.mjs.reason: DEFECT. More than seven document types block when every optional field is filled, so filling in more detail makes a document less exportable.
signature_contains: no more than seven types block with every optional field filled

poshDissemination.test.mjs.reason: PREMISE DRIFT. The POSH policy text no longer contains the display sentence this test was written against. Rewrite the test rather than delete it, per its own message.
signature_contains: the policy no longer asserts display

poshFalsification.test.mjs.reason: DEFECT. The baseline POSH policy does not generate. Part of the same generation breakage as the loan fixtures.
signature_contains: the baseline POSH policy does not generate

positionOverride.test.mjs.reason: DEFECT. LOAN_AGREEMENT fixture does not generate. Same symptom as loanApplicability.test.mjs.
signature_contains: LOAN_AGREEMENT: fixture must generate

propositionCoverage.test.mjs.reason: DEFECT. A legal proposition is applicable in some world and no clause in the document implements it, so a user in that situation gets a document missing a protection the engine knows applies.
signature_contains: A legal proposition is applicable in some world and implemented by no clause

propositionVocabulary.test.mjs.reason: EVIDENCE GAP. The falsification set no longer contains the two control clauses it needs, so it cannot prove anything either way. Remove once the controls are restored.
signature_contains: the falsification needs at least two control clauses

requiredFieldCoverage.test.mjs.reason: DEFECT. The variable injector's defaults are not found (0 of them). Note: on Windows this file also fails for an unrelated path bug in the test itself; on Linux the path resolves and this is the genuine failure underneath.
signature_contains: every placeholder in an unconditional clause is a required field
expected the injector defaults to be found, got 0

semanticMerge.test.mjs.reason: DEFECT. mergeAIDraftWithSeed is not preserving the full seed clause set, which is the one guarantee that keeps document structure with the rule engine rather than the AI. High priority.
signature_contains: all seed clauses preserved

statuteCurrency.test.mjs.reason: DEFECT. scripts/checkStatuteCitations.mjs exits non-zero because of malformed and/or unresolvable citations in the live clause library (not repealed-Act citations). This signature is weaker than the others because the script's JSON output is truncated in the captured log; strengthen it by making the test assert on the parsed report rather than on exec success.
signature_contains: all four labour Codes are registered
Command failed:

statutoryCustody.test.mjs.reason: BOOKKEEPING. Recorded clause/statute pairings no longer occur. Re-record with --write once the change behind them is confirmed intentional.
signature_contains: Recorded pairings no longer occur

tosFalsification.test.mjs.reason: PREMISE DRIFT. The document no longer makes the self-certifying free consent claim this evidence was gathered against. Re-gather the evidence rather than let it pass against an easier fixture.
signature_contains: the document no longer makes the self-certifying free consent claim
